audit_target: Disaster Recovery, Emergency Read & Permit Replay Security

findings.title: Unauthenticated Offline Emergency Read Permitted Arbitrary Local Read
findings.state_prior: execute_emergency_read bypassed authorization checks, allowing reading any shard without principal credentials or manifest verification.
findings.remediation: Implemented execute_secure_emergency_read with Ed25519-signed RecoveryCapabilityToken, RecoveryTrustStore, manifest signature verification, and namespace isolation.

findings.title: Permit Replay Vulnerability in Shard Deletion & Garbage Collection
findings.state_prior: Permits lacked retention watermark verification, meaning a DeleteShard or GarbageCollectShard permit could delete shards from retained or checkpointed generations.
findings.remediation: Added strict retention watermark and checkpoint protection checks in NodeEpochFencingTracker. Storage nodes reject deletions of generations <= retention watermark or current active generation.

findings.title: Metadata Snapshot Rollback Risk During Catastrophic Recovery
findings.state_prior: Manual or unauthenticated coordinator state restore could revert metadata state machine to an earlier commit index.
findings.remediation: Implemented DisasterRecoveryBackupBundle with operator Ed25519 signature, SHA-256 digest validation, and automatic rollback rejection unless explicitly overridden by authorized operator.

findings.title: Silent Corruption / Bitrot Risk During Emergency Reconstruction
findings.state_prior: Emergency reconstruction did not check individual shard SHA-256 digests against signed manifest records before decoding.
findings.remediation: execute_secure_emergency_read independently validates each shard's SHA-256 digest against the signed StripeManifest, discards corrupt shards, increments corrupted_shards_detected, and gathers clean surviving shards.
